CPL simplifies equal constant k2/Q for both bodies; ACT assumes primary/satellite rigidity4e10/4e9Pa, equal viscosities and satellite rubble-pile interpretation. Not measured local strength, porosity or chemistry.
Integration stops at pericentre crossing fluid Roche limit or primary breakup. Not an observed disruption/impact history.
Primary permanent-shape/precession effects distinguished from dissipative tide; neglecting J2 for broad evolution does not validate a current pointing/frame/registered site.
